description: This file defines a Flutter widget called NotifyMeCard, which provides a UI component for users to enable or disable notifications when a product is back in stock. It includes UI elements such as an icon, label text, and a toggle switch, with styling adapted based on the notification state.

classes.name: NotifyMeCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a notification toggle with styling that depends on whether notifications are enabled.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the NotifyMeCard, including UI elements like icon, text, and switch.
